statements.statement: The service billed was cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The denial reason code was PR-204
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The note indicates prolonged rhythm monitoring to evaluate for potential embolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
